items.question: What morning ritual duties are enjoined upon the pavilion-lord regarding the deities?
premises: The pavilion-lord is addressed as the ritual agent.
Bathing is prescribed as a morning action.
Worship of the deities follows the act of bathing.
items.inference: Therefore, the pavilion-lord must bathe in the morning and then worship the deities.
uncertainties: The specific deities intended by devatāḥ are not named in this verse.
items.plain_english: O lord of the pavilion, having bathed in the morning, you should then worship the deities.
